## Doubtful readings (kept as printed, said so)
- **149 `Feretro Pallanta reposto`** (Latin Library `Pallante`). As printed, construed as ablative absolute `feretro reposto` with `super` governing `Pallanta` ("he fell forward over Pallas"); the other reading is the ablative absolute "Pallas being laid on the bier". The note gives both; the sense is the same. Could be a misprint copied from 141/163, but the printed text construes, so kept.
- **173 `in armis`** (Latin Library `in arvis`). Greenough's reading kept and translated ("a huge trunk in arms", a trophy); the other noted in the unit (sense changes).
- **170–171** bracketed by Greenough as spurious; kept in [ ] in t, l and i; the note (ln 169) says what changes with and without them (`alio… quam`; subject of `ferunt` 172).

Variants ignored as orthography/morphology: 128 `siqua` (note gives `si qua`), 134 `inpune` (note gives `impune`), 151 `vocis`/`voci` (sense unchanged), 167/178/181 `natum`/`gnatum`, 194 `ensesque`/`ensis-`.
